reason_for_inclusion: A maintained Python desktop P2P client with GUI, networking, and plugins in one mid-sized organically grown codebase.
what_it_tests: Desktop layering, GUI versus protocol logic, plugin boundaries, and tracing data flow through loosely coupled subsystems.
risks_or_caveats: Legacy naming and inconsistent style can mislead superficial analysis.

reason_for_inclusion: A small native C application whose processing pipeline is more layered than its size suggests.
what_it_tests: Pipeline-style architecture detection, hardware abstraction boundaries, and whether small repos get oversimplified.
risks_or_caveats: Some boundaries are clearer in runtime behavior than in file layout.

reason_for_inclusion: A widely used Windows utility with deliberate monolithic areas, platform APIs, and embedded subsystems.
what_it_tests: Windows-native architecture, intentional coupling versus accidental coupling, and subsystem detection in non-framework code.
risks_or_caveats: Heavy Win32 usage may be outside the comfort zone of web-centric models.

reason_for_inclusion: A cross-platform transcoder with a shared core and multiple frontends, making UI-core separation explicit and important.
what_it_tests: Library versus application boundary detection, multi-frontend architecture, and cross-language integration patterns.
risks_or_caveats: Native GUI diversity and codec-domain complexity increase labeling cost.

reason_for_inclusion: A Windows launcher with a plugin-host architecture hidden behind a deceptively flat repository layout.
what_it_tests: Detection of plugin hosts, dependency inversion, and architecture inference beyond shallow directory reading.
risks_or_caveats: Intermittent development means some bundled plugin code may be stale.

reason_for_inclusion: A messy but real Windows application combining services, local UI, IPC, hardware monitoring, and updater logic.
what_it_tests: Hybrid service-plus-UI architecture, IPC boundaries, hardware abstractions, and component labeling without standard conventions.
risks_or_caveats: Domain and Windows service constraints add evaluation complexity.
